requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity solutions, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, into the Magellan printer to enhance workflow efficiency and manageability for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: AI features will provide a competitive edge and meet the productivity needs of SMBs with limited IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with device firmware and SMB portal; dependent on AI software readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer offers AI-powered Perfect Print and Perfect Scan features accessible through device interface and SMB portal; verified through user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated SMB portal for easy management, monitoring, and support of multiple printers in unmanaged/lightly managed SMB environments.
requirements.Rationale: Target customers lack dedicated IT; a simple, unified portal will reduce management overhead and improve customer satisfaction.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, R&D Telemetry, DVAR, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires backend infrastructure and integration with printer firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal allows registration, configuration, monitoring, and support for all Magellan printers in a small business environment; tested with real SMB users.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer to deliver HP's lowest business TCO via efficient ink tank technology, minimal intervention, and cost-effective supplies.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a key purchase driver for SMBs; will differentiate Magellan from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink tank system design and supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent cost analysis shows Magellan has the lowest TCO in HP's SMB portfolio; validated through competitive benchmarking.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure the Magellan printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a growing priority for SMBs and provides a strong competitive differentiator.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, Prod Steward, Tech Reg, Quality
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing and manufacturing process changes to meet RCP target.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and third-party audit confirm 60% RCP in final product.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that can be swapped by the customer, minimizing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces reliance on service centers and appeals to SMBs with limited IT support.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design validation for user replaceability and safety.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace maintenance box without tools; verified by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance to SMBs and supports the value proposition of reliability and low TCO.
requirements.Dependencies: Warranty terms must be supported by hardware reliability testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation and marketing materials reflect 80k/2yr terms; validated by legal/quality teams.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure system reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error, protects print quality, and minimizes support calls.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle and tank redesign; supply chain adaptation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Only correct bottle fits corresponding tank; verified by mechanical testing.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure non-PDL SKU supports SMB2.0 solutions and the Advanced View SMB portal for enhanced business functionality.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances business productivity and device manageability for non-PDL customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU passes certification for SMB2.0 and Advanced View portal integration.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Enable Platform as a Service (PaaS) capabilities for Magellan printers to facilitate cloud-based management and services.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategic goal for PaaS acceleration and provides recurring value to SMB customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, R&D Telemetry, BA, DVAR
requirements.Dependencies: Requires cloud infrastructure integration and security compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printers can be managed and serviced via HP's PaaS platform; validated by integration tests.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Improved Print Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: For PDL SKU, deliver minimum print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from 25/19) and ensure support for PDL/PS.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses business segment needs for faster, professional printing and compatibility with enterprise workflows.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware optimization for speed and PDL/PS support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm and passes PDL/PS compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification (PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel certification for the PDL SKU to meet environmental and energy efficiency standards.
requirements.Rationale: Required for sales in certain regions and supports HP's sustainability messaging.
requirements.Stakeholders: Tech Reg, Prod Steward, Marketing, Quality
requirements.Dependencies: Must meet Blue Angel requirements through design and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU listed as Blue Angel certified by official registry.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printers support mobile printing through the HP App for ease of use and remote access.
requirements.Rationale: Meets SMB user demand for flexible, on-the-go printing.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP App ecosystem.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is discoverable and usable from HP App on iOS/Android; verified by functional testing.

requirements.Title: High Serviceability: PHA and MINK at Service Centre
requirements.Description: Design for high serviceability, allowing PHA (customer replaceable) and MINK (service center replaceable) parts, with target for most to be customer replaceable if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and cost for SMBs; improves customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Design validation for replaceability and safety.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Parts classified and tested as PHA or MINK; service documentation updated.

requirements.Title: Telemetry and Analytics Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for device health, usage, and predictive maintenance reporting.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, improves reliability, and supports managed service offerings.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires secure data collection and cloud integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, transmitted securely, and accessible via SMB portal; validated by data integrity and privacy tests.
